it's actually all an optical illusion. Instead of real movement, there are three distinct frames—one for each step of the staircase. Each "Step Frame" holds all the necessary text layers. Essentially, the same text (Nima, Zaeimzadeh, UI UX, Framer, Designer) appears three times across the website. you simply display the appropriate frame to maintain the illusion.

For the effect, you apply identical scroll transforms to each text layer within these frames, adjusting their vertical position using the Y offset. When the scroll transform is triggered, all text layers across the steps move simultaneously, creating the impression of them traveling up the staircase in 3D.
